##### Project general facts

Samana Mykonos is an exquisite development by the award-winning SAMANA Developers that brings the enchanting spirit of the legendary Greek island, offering luxury living with a holiday vibe. The magnificent design draws inspiration from Mykonos's famous minimal Cycladic architecture, featuring striking aesthetics with vibrant hues of blue and white that leave an everlasting sensory experience. The thoughtfully crafted development offers spacious interiors, airy balconies, and beautifully adorned urban gardens that allow residents to revel in the warmth of nature while enjoying a lifestyle that resonates with their dream home.

The development boasts an exceptional array of amenities that redefine luxury living, featuring a magnificent leisure pool deck and a stunning lagoon-style main pool that provides a beach-like feel in the heart of the city. Residents can maintain their wellness routine in the high-end indoor and outdoor gyms, complemented by luxurious sauna and steam room facilities for ultimate relaxation. Additional conveniences include valet parking, solar panels, outdoor cinema, barbecue area, and a rooftop theatre that offers an unparalleled entertainment experience under the stars.

Each residence showcases modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The thoughtfully designed interiors embrace the vibrant colors and artistic heritage of the Greek island, while equipped kitchens feature premium appliances and fixtures. The crowning feature of every residence is the private pool, offering residents an unparalleled touch of privacy and luxury that transforms each home into a personal sanctuary of relaxation.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious residential development is situated in Dubai Studio City, a vibrant community that has established itself as a premier destination for media production and creative industries. The area is home to popular shopping destinations, international food chains, local restaurants, and numerous recreational spots that cater to every lifestyle need. The community's strategic positioning ensures that residents enjoy a perfect balance of professional opportunity and leisure appeal.

The location offers remarkable convenience with everything needed for everyday life nearby, ensuring seamless access to essential services and amenities. The area benefits from excellent connectivity to other key districts of Dubai, making it easy to explore the city's diverse attractions and business hubs. The community's thoughtful urban planning creates an environment that supports both work and play.

The strategic positioning provides convenient access to major destinations, allowing residents to enjoy Dubai's world-famous attractions with ease. The neighborhood's ongoing development makes it an increasingly attractive destination for professionals and families seeking a vibrant yet peaceful living environment. This distinguished area represents the perfect combination of creative energy, modern convenience, and strategic accessibility.
